svg.text: Velocity, octave, gate, mod (a step held: its own; GLO: tempo, swing, scale, root)
White keys: the page's steps · Black keys 1-8: the rows (Multitrack: tracks), then the page back, on, and MUTE · Hold any button a second: what it does
